hooks.command: FILE_PATH=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); if [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *.py ]]; then cd $(dirname "$FILE_PATH") && uv run ruff format "$FILE_PATH" && uv run ruff check --fix "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); dir=$(basename "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir')"); cd "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir')" 2>/dev/null; printf '\033[2m\033[32m➜\033[0m '; printf '\033[2m\033[36m%s\033[0m' "$dir"; if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); if ! git diff --quiet 2>/dev/null || ! git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then dirty=' \033[2m\033[33m✗\033[0m'; else dirty=''; fi; printf ' \033[2m\033[34mgit:(\033[31m%s\033[34m)%b\033[0m' "$branch" "$dirty"; fi; printf ' \033[2m| \033[35m%s\033[0m' "$model"
